title: Mixed Event — Carnation Recollection

meta.Outline: Despite Kanade's persistent efforts to save Mafuyu, none of the songs she composes seem to leave an impression on her. Feeling like she's reached a dead end, Kanade heads to SEKAI for advice...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<What? Still?
But this demo sounded amazing.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah, I thought so too. I guess this one couldn't really get its hooks into Yuki.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <But this is the fourth one now, right? Can't you say anything more than just, “I don't know”...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Ugh...! K's been working her butt off trying to make this song better, so you should do her a little courtesy and try a little harder.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <It's okay. I can make it again.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <This one didn't resonate with Yuki, so I'll keep trying until something does...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I guess we don't really have a choice. Also, K, have you been getting enough sleep lately? Take a break if you need one, okay?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <All work and no play turns your brain into mush, right?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yuki, I'll try making a new demo but you'll have to wait until tomorrow night to hear it.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I have to get up early tomorrow, so bye.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I don't get it. Does Yuki just not understand how hard you've been working on these songs, K?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Calm down, girl. I'm sure she's trying her best, so let's just give her a little more time.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Anyways, I'm gonna log off too.
See ya!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Um, K? I know we just mentioned this, but don't push yourself too hard, okay?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I get that you want to make a song that can save Yuki, but I don't think rushing like this is the right answer.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (It seems like she's been able to feel more lately, but it's still not enough...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (How do I actually make a song that can save Yuki...?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: No, thinking about it won't get me anywhere...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I just have to keep composing...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Until now, Kanade's songs made my chest ache or helped me relax when I listened to them.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(Even now, I feel something there...
A part of me that isn't at ease...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (But I don't know why that is...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Yeah. I like how this song's coming along...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Thanks for waiting, everyone.
The new demo's done.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<You're done already, K?
That was really fast...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, what's it like? I can't wait to hear it!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <It's nothing. Can I listen to it now?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Sure. I'll upload it to Nightcord... Oh...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Would it be okay with everyone if we listened to this together in SEKAI...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Ta-daa!
The N25 Rangers are here to save the day!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Whoa, cold as ice!
I saw this superhero cartoon on TV this morning, so I wanted to tell Miku about it is all...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah, yeah...
You really like dumb stuff like that, don't you...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But Mizuki does look more cheerful than before...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But it's pretty rare for you to suggest doing something like this, Kanade. I mean, we can just listen to it together on Nightcord.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I want to hear what you all have to say in person this time.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I know that Mafuyu can feel strong emotions in certain situations.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Like that time when we saw those cherry blossoms. She clearly spoke her mind and even smiled as we looked on...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (That has to be some kind of hint. I don't want to let that go and miss my chance to make a song that can save her.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No way... Are you Megurine Luka?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Yes, that's me.
I just recently arrived in this SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
It's nice to finally meet you all.
Miku's told me all about you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Uh, right... It's nice to meet you too...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
First MEIKO and now Luka?
This place is starting to get crowded all the sudden.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Why are you looking at me like that...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: This is just me talking, but maybe you really are starting to change inside, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So what brings you all here today?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, we came here to listen to a demo of our next song together. Would you mind giving it a listen as well?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Of course. I'd love to hear it.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you. I'll get everything started.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, this intro's awesome...!
I love this vibe.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, it really tells you what's going on from the start. Nice one, K!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(I wonder what Mafuyu thinks.
I hope she feels something.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: No, I'm not sure it actually was...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I appreciate you all gathering here for this, but I need to start making fixes to this demo.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What? But it was such a good song... Right?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Maybe...
But I feel like it needs adjusting...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Well, when you're finished, I'd love to hear it again.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I've been trying to compose songs around what Mafuyu seems to be thinking or feeling...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But lately, songs that I've been making this way haven't been striking a chord with her...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I want to make something that really resonates with what she's feeling but...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<K, are you okay?
Have you been getting enough sleep?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <But I still haven't managed to compose a song that resonates well with Yuki. I have to get it right this time...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I thought they were all good, but it's still not enough for Yuki, huh?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Who knows?
We don't have a clue as to what's going through her head.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <But that means we're at a complete dead end!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <And K's gonna collapse from exhaustion if she keeps this up. We have to think of something...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Okay, well... Yuki's biggest reaction so far came from hearing “Marionette”, right...?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Right. Yuki even put pen to paper by turning what she felt but couldn't describe into its lyrics...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <So we're lacking that sort of inspiration...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah. That song's lyrics are all about describing something that you can't quite put into words, right?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Doesn't that mean if Yuki might actually feel something if she's inspired by K's song in a similar way?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I mean... There was that thing with me, remember?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I was ready to just give up on everything, but you made that song for me, K.... After listening to it, I felt a lot better and even decided to draw again.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <The songs you make, K... They sort of compel you to look at yourself in the mirror.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I'm sure that if Yuki can feel the same way, she'll come to some kind of realization...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I was so determined while making that song for Yuki after I found her in SEKAI. It was the same when I made that song for Enanan too.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Maybe that's it. I have to become completely immersed in the songwriting like I was back then...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I tried to remember the way I was when I made “Marionette” for Yuki or that other song for Ena...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Will this finally be the one that reaches Yuki?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm not even sure myself at this point...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (A hint... Or even just someone to talk to... But I doubt anyone's going to be online right now...)
<Oh, is everything okay? You have quite a serious expression on your face...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe. I was wondering how things were going for you.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
For now, yes.
I made a new demo...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Um, Luka...
Would you mind listening to it for me?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I can't really reach anyone else right now so...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yes, of course. I'd love to hear it.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm not sure this song will be able to clear up what's on that girl's mind...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I also suspect that you're still not sure where you're going with this song.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: What is it that you want people to see or realize by hearing this?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You don't seem to have considered that and it'll end up meaningless if there's no goal to reach.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: This will just leave everyone wandering endlessly in the darkness...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That is all I have to say regarding this...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'll try considering what you just said.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, MEIKO. I was wondering where you were...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Don't play coy with me. You knew I was here the whole time.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. But you saw all of that just now, yes? You could've joined us and helped her out...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm doing everything I can to not do that.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: What you just said may cause Kanade to rethink things quite a bit. It may even send her down the wrong path...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'd prefer it if you didn't say anything that might upset people like that.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It's important to watch over them, but sometimes it's necessary to break something down or take it apart if it's stalled and won't start.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I believe that is why I'm here.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Out of curiosity, MEIKO, what kind of song do you think she'll come to us with next?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: What do I want her to see or realize...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Huh?!
Oh, my alarm... But for what...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, right...
I need to go visit dad at the hospital today.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I have to start getting ready and... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
It's raining again...
The weather's been so bad lately...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: No, I don't have time for that. I need to hurry...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But even if he is awake, which “dad” is he going to be...?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Here's to hoping for a real conversation...)

rows.Speaker: Nurse
rows.Line:
You came at a good time.
Your father's awake.

rows.Speaker: Nurse
rows.Line: However, it's difficult to say how much he can remember at the moment...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thank you...
I'll try talking to him.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Good morning.
Or afternoon, I guess...

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: I'm sorry. I'm not sure I got your name.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line:
I apologize for not remembering...
Apparently, stress from work caused my memory to become pretty jumbled.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: Again, I'm so sorry. After you came all this way to visit. I can't seem to remember anything about my family either...

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line:
Yes.
We're actually about to become parents.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: My wife's in her second trimester and her belly's been growing so much...

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: I know that I need to be by her side as much as possible, but look at me... How can I in this state...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I know that you're a kind person who cares about his family very much, Mr. Yoisaki.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line:
Haha. Thank you.
Also, I didn't catch your name...

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line:
Kanade? What a coincidence.
We're thinking about calling our baby that.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: My wife and I love music very much, so we're hoping that we'll be able to enjoy it together as a family...

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: Look at me. I'm just rambling on about myself.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I hope you get better soon.
Especially for your family's sake...

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: Me too. Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Nurse
rows.Line: He went back in time quite a ways today...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, he did...
But I'm glad that I got to see him doing so well.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Anyways, I've dropped off his change of clothes, so if you'll excuse me...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I have no right to feel this sad...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I'm the one that did this to dad.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(I don't have time to feel bad.
I have to keep composing.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I have to save Mafuyu. I have to save as many people as I can with my music.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Is that Kanade...?
Oh, maybe she's on her way home after visiting her dad.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But I probably shouldn't butt in unannounced. Plus, we'll talk on Nightcord later, so I guess I don't need to go up to her now and...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hang on... What? She's not using an umbrella!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(She'll catch a cold if she doesn't...
She looks so sad too...
Could something have happened to her?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Mizuki...?
What are you doing here...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I'm on my way home from work.
More importantly, why are you walking around in the rain without an umbrella? You'll get sick, you know?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, I was just thinking about something...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (She's really been pushing herself with that new song too. I can't just leave her like this...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I have to finish that song...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It won't help Mafuyu at all at this rate. I have to keep working on it...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Sorry, I need to go home...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh? Hey, hold on one sec!!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: There's a super cute cafe just around the corner here. Wanna check it out together, Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
It'll just be for a little bit!
A little break before you get back to that song!

rows.Speaker: Shop Clerk
rows.Line:
Here you are.
Your chocolate parfait and a cup of hot tea.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Time to dig in!
Oh, wow... It's so good♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That's because you were walking around in this weather without an umbrella.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Right. At least my clothes are starting to dry out now.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Thank goodness! And why don't you get something to eat, Kanade? I'll pay too since I kinda dragged you in here!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thanks, but I'm really not that hungry.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Okay...
But tell me if you do, okay?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
And isn't this place great?
I love this place so much since everything on the menu's amazing and the adorable decor.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So is the demo giving you a rough time...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It is. I haven't made much progress...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I see.
But you don't need to feel rushed...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: The demo that I had you all listen to didn't really resonate with Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So I need to finish another one for tonight.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I have a feeling that I'm just going to get the same result...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Resonate...? You won't know until you try! I think you should just have her give it a listen, you know?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
No, it's not just that.
A part of me knows that it won't.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Luka even said so.
That it won't clear up what's on Mafuyu's mind.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Clear up what's on her mind...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I can't quite put my finger on it, but I think I know what Luka was trying to say. I haven't made up my mind yet, and it's why I feel so lost.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Nothing's going to work at this rate...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But I want to help her in any way I can...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You're really up a creek, huh? And Luka said that your song won't help Mafuyu as it is...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I know! Why don't we go out and do something together?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah! You need to clear your head, right? Being cooped up at home definitely won't help, so why not get a breath of fresh air instead?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Who knows? You might even find something that'll help you save Mafuyu!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (The trip that Mizuki suggested we all go on did give us some ideas for a new song.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Maybe seeing something new is the right answer in this case too...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (And if it means that I'll be able to compose a song that can save Mafuyu...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But I probably should've decided on something before suggesting this...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Let me think... Got it! We can start with that place! Follow me, Kanade!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah. Remember how Mafuyu reacted when we all went to that Doll Exhibit?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So I thought that it might help you figure out something too!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But I wasn't directly responsible for that. Which means... I have to come up with something more powerful than that...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That sound... Is it a music box?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, I think it's this doll...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, it plays a music box when you wind it up! That's really cute!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yeah, you're right.
It's a nice song too...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Come to think of it, you include a lot of music box sounds in your songs, huh?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Even that last one you made. It's like you're putting your signature on each song, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, I never thought about it like that...
But I do like music boxes quite a bit.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Especially the one my dad made.
I used to listen to that one a lot.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That might be why I'm so fascinated by them.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
It must've been a really good song.
What was it like?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
It was so gentle...
Just listening to it made you feel...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Anyways, let's check out our next stop...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Phew... We really looked all over.
How are you feeling? Tired?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: No, I feel good. It's a weekday so there aren't that many people around, but I still haven't figured anything out regarding Mafuyu...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, yeah...
I felt like that art exhibit with all those landscapes would do the trick too...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, I can see why. Mafuyu smiled when we saw those cherry blossoms so...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: She's even been complimenting Ena's artwork too, sometimes. Maybe art's the key to getting her to feel more?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Right. If we keep looking at artsy things, we might just...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hm? What's up?
Did that flower shop catch your eye...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, white carnations!
I always see red or pink ones, but these white ones are really pretty too!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, uh... Not me...
My mom did...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: She always kept some around the house, and I bring her these every time I go visit her grave.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm sorry. I didn't mean to...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
No, it's okay.
I'm sorry for asking without really thinking it through first.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
But flowers are great, aren't they?
They have this therapeutic quality to them...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It'd be great to even see a whole field of them. One with lavenders and sunflowers... It'd be so beautiful...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I vaguely remember my dad taking us to see one a long time ago.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Really? Like a field of carnations...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. It was fairly close by too, I think. I remember being surprised by how you could see something like that in the city.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I remember having so much fun then... The weather was nice and everyone was laughing...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, Kanade. Wanna try finding that flower field together?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
It's somewhere around here, right?
There's only a few places in the city where something like that could be, so I'm sure we'll find it pretty quick!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But it's still raining... Are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, totally!
I've got my favorite rainboots on too, so it'd be nice to get a little more mileage on them!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Then let's start with... Miyamasuzaka Park. That's been there forever, and it's huge!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Man... We've checked out every park around here, but nothing...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Maybe I'm confusing it with somewhere else. It might not actually be in the city like I said.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm so sorry for making you do this. Especially considering the weather...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Let's just keep looking, alright?
It could still be on the other side of the station, you know?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
No it's okay. Let's stop for now.
Thank you for doing this.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Sorry I couldn't help you find it...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But maybe some other time we can...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Will I still be friends with her when that time comes...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Uh... N-Nothing. It's nothing.
Something was bugging me is all.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But you're heading back to the station, right? We can use this park as a shortcut to get there.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: This rain really isn't letting up, huh? All we've been getting lately is bad weather too...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But you might even think of a good song when it's finally sunny again, so I wouldn't fret too much, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And whenever you feel like hanging out again, you know who to call!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Right, I'll keep that in mind.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It was nice doing something like this for a change.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: To tell you the truth, I went to visit my dad today...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Ever since he had his breakdown, his memory's become jumbled. He talked about the time before I was born today...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Then it reminded me of how I took away his happiness. I felt so awful afterwards...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That was when I thought that I have to compose a song that can save Mafuyu as soon as I can.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I convinced myself that I had no right to be there unless I did that first...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I feel much better after you took me around to visit all these other places, Mizuki...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (She thinks what happened to her dad is all her fault and is making songs like this as some sort of punishment.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I want to tell her that it's not her fault and she doesn't have to do this...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But I doubt that'll make her stop. It probably doesn't matter who tells her.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You keep saying that you haven't been able to save anyone yet.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But I can say for sure that you saved me. At least, the old me.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Since I was little, I thought that living life was way too hard and really didn't like it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Then, around junior high, I convinced myself that everything would be better if I just disappeared.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But that was when I heard one of your songs.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I felt that I'd found someone that was just like me.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I felt like trying a little harder after hearing it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, it's letting up!
You think it'll stop soon?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
It looks like it.
Everyone else is starting to put away their umbrellas.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yay!
All this rain's really been such a drag...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Speaking of which, there's actually one more spot that I want to show you. Wanna check it out since it's finally stopped raining?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Sure, I'd like to see it.
What's it like?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That's a secret! Well, not really. You can't actually hide a place like this...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's that place with the fountain that's just nearby. It has all these little flowerbeds and looks so pretty♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Look, you can sort of see it now!

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: Hm? Kanade, you have something on your cheek.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line:
Your other cheek, silly.
Just stay still for me.
Oh, are you sure about that?

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line: Kanade isn't the only one with something on their cheek, honey.

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line:
Mommy, look!
Daddy did the same things as me!

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line:
It's on this cheek.
Stay still now.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line:
There, got it.
Were you trying to copy Kanade, dear?

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line: Careful not to trip and fall, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line: Mommy, look! The butterfly stopped on the flower!

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line: Yes, I see. Butterflies love to eat flower nectar very much, so it must be lunchtime for it too.

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line:
It's eating a flower for lunch?
Do flowers taste good...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line:
These are carnations.
They're my favorite type of flower.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line: Kanade, wait! Please don't run off like that!

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line: Let's give daddy a big round of applause!

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: That one? Well, I sort of just played it off hand, so it doesn't really have a name...

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line:
But let's see...
We can call it, “Kanade and Mommy's Happy Sunday”...!

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line: Haha! That's such a silly name!

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line: Kanade, you know it's not nice to say things like that. You'll make your father sad.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: As long as my music makes you and your mother smile, I'll be more than happy.

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line: Me smiling makes you smile too, daddy?

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: Yes, it does. It makes me feel all warm and fuzzy inside.

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line:
Really?!
Then I promise to smile lots and lots!

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line:
Hehe...
Would you mind playing us that song one more time, honey?

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: You got it! Get ready for an encore!

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line: I suppose I just can't help it...

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line: Your father's music always finds a way to make me smile.

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line:
Yeah, me too...!
I love the music daddy plays!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: This is what my parents and I saw.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
What?!
But this isn't really a glamorous flower field. It's just a bunch of flower beds...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
No, I got it!
You came when you were little, so it looked a lot bigger than it really was!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, you may be right.
Sorry for the confusion...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: No, that's totally fine! I'm just glad that we found it! There really are a lot of carnations here, huh?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Remembering what happened that day's making me feel worse.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Even after Mizuki went through the trouble of finding this place. But if I recall any more than this, I might...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: This place really means a lot to you, doesn't it, Kanade...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Sorry, it's just that I'm glad to have learned that because you hardly ever talk about yourself or stuff like this, you know?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You had this great expression on your face when you saw these flowers too. You seemed so happy.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, I'm glad we did this...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Nevermind, ignore that last part! Look at me...! Talking like I know everything about you...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I wouldn't have been able to remember anything if it weren't for you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Like my memories from when I was little and why I liked this place so much.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Would you mind telling me more? About what happened back then and stuff?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: My parents and I came here on a picnic.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Dad even brought his guitar and sang for us.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It was a really simple song, but it was so gentle and happy...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Because of that, listening to it usually cheers me up.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You're talking about that music box your dad made, right? It has to be good if you're willing to say this much. It'd be great to listen to it sometime too...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, I can bring it with me next time if you want...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, I'd like you to hear it too.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (When is the last time I talked about my past like this...?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I'd forgotten about what happened back then for so long...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Or rather, I kept it locked away in the back of my mind...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (We were so happy back then, remembering it all now felt painful...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But I'm glad I was able to.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (This place meant so much to me, and it still does...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But what are the odds that one of my favorite places would turn out to be this kind of blast from the past for you, Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm not sure I would've been able to handle what I just felt if I came here alone.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I was able to look back on what happened then with a more open mind thanks to you, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Mizuki helped remind me about a lot of things today.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I'm still not sure what kind of song will save Mafuyu, but that's okay...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I just have to keep trying.
No matter how long it takes.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It feels like I've taken a step closer, but some things are still missing...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It needs to be softer and gentler...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (It's so gentle and warm, like I'm being wrapped in a blanket. Dad's songs have these qualities.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But what am I missing? How did dad capture these feelings so well...?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (When he made this song, he was...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: As long as my music makes you and your mother smile, I'll be more than happy.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: As long as it made us smile even a little bit...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Dad sang that song because he wanted mom and me to smile...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(So what's my goal?
What do I want for Mafuyu?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I... I just don't want her to disappear...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (No, that's just a personal desire. I want her to stay so that I don't get hurt...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (What do I want her to feel? What do I want her to do?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I want her to be her the way she wants to be... I think...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But I don't know who that Mafuyu is. What's going to happen when she does find the “real” her?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I really wasn't thinking about Mafuyu's best interests, was I...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'll be stuck in a loop at this rate...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: What is it that you want people to see or realize by hearing this?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: What do I want people to realize...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: What do I want Mafuyu to realize...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line: Your father's music always finds a way to make me smile.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I'm not sure I can put it into words but...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I want her to be able to feel a lot of different emotions like mom did back then...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: This seems completely different from anything I made before...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (What kind of expression will Mafuyu have on her face after listening to this?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I want all of them to listen to it.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I know you're both busy and were just about to get started, but thanks for meeting me here.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Nah, it's all good! I just sat down a second ago so it's not like I was really doing anything.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Same here.
And Mafuyu said she'll be running late, right...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. She said she has to get ready for cram school.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So what are we doing? Listening to another song?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. There's something I'd like you to listen to. Would that be alright, Rin?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You feel pretty good about it...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm not sure if it'll strike a chord with Mafuyu but... Oh...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Is it true that you made a new demo...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes.
More than that, it's basically a full song.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Would you like to listen to it...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You could say that a little nicer, you know? She went through the trouble of making this for you...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I didn't mean to be rude.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm saying the way you naturally talk is rude!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Okay, okay! Relax!
Let's just settle down and listen to Kanade's song!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah, we know, we listened to it too.
Don't you have anything else to say?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm not sure how to describe it...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But I liked it, I think...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Why do you all look so surprised?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, you have no idea what you just did?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You smiled, Mafuyu! It's because of Kanade's song!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
What made you smile?
Was it the chorus?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I don't know...
I don't know but...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That is what you all want to feel.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Whoa, it's pretty late.
I'm gonna head off in a bit too.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I was able to compose that song because you helped me open my eyes.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I opened your eyes...? Haha. You're exaggerating way too much, K.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I'm glad that I was able to help.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (For the longest time, I had such a cynical view of the world and just assumed that none of it mattered...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But if Kanade's saying that I was actually able to help her, I guess the things I've done up to this point weren't a complete waste.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (She's such an incredible human being too...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Not only does she have to take care of her dad, she keeps making all these songs even though she's dealing with so many other things.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (She works tirelessly to try and save people.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Giving up has probably never crossed her mind...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Will I be able to change if I do that too?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
But still...
Kanade's really something else.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: She's the reason the old me and the current me have been able to keep going.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, I need to try a little harder too. I don't have a big goal or anything yet...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But I can start by making a music video that fits this song perfectly!
